name: Detects Compliance Finding
description: A scanner detects a compliance finding directly, with no run between them. Only for a tool that has no discrete executions (Dependabot, a continuous service); a tool that has runs reports through PERFORMS_COMPLIANCE_SCAN_RUN and REPORTS_COMPLIANCE_FINDING, so the two paths never both describe one finding. The tool_version and category properties are optional and are the continuous service's own statement, not a run's.

tool_version.description: The tool version the service reported for this detection, when it reports one.

category.description: What was scanned, as the service labels it, when it labels it.
